title: Canopy — dog shop website and local service
brief: Review example 1 of 2: a fictional online dog shop with a physical store. Covers website, business and general-planning nodes. Product and operating claims are examples to validate.
objective: Help customers choose suitable dog products, buy online or plan a useful store visit, while keeping staff work manageable.
success: A reviewer can explain the main path and identify the unresolved choices.
Technology names, rationale and diagram nodes can be annotated individually.
No optional capability is silently treated as a launch requirement.

now: Product browsing, product detail, cart and platform checkout.
Visit page, sizing support and honest product guidance.
One agreed stock owner and a launch workflow staff can operate.
later: Only add optional capabilities after evidence supports them.
out: Purchasing services, deploying systems or producing final creative assets during this review.

context.detail: This is a fictional but concrete review plan created to exercise the planning toolkit and its node types.
context.source: User request: create two or three plans covering the node catalogue.

context.detail: Actual budget, team capacity, existing systems and delivery dates have not been supplied.
Technology and production-tool choices below are reviewable proposals, not approved purchases.

technologies.name: Shopify — managed commerce
technologies.role: Hosted catalogue, orders, checkout and platform data. No separate custom database/backend is proposed.
technologies.rationale: A managed starting option for a small shop if its existing system cannot support the goal.
technologies.tradeoffs: Subscription, checkout constraints and integration fit need review; this is not a cost quote.
alternatives: Reuse an existing capable commerce platform.
WooCommerce if the team already maintains WordPress.
impacts: Products, variants, checkout, stock and order handling
checks: Verify country/payment availability and the existing till integration.
Run a test order, refund and stock reconciliation.
technologies.versionPlan: No versions are fabricated or installed in this planning example. Before implementation, inspect existing manifests, choose compatible supported releases, record exact versions in the lockfile, and test updates.

technologies.name: Liquid + HTML/CSS + small JavaScript modules
technologies.role: Reusable theme sections and custom branded controls.
technologies.rationale: Uses the commerce platform’s page model without adding a second frontend application.
technologies.tradeoffs: Platform template constraints; custom interactions still need keyboard and mobile testing.
alternatives: A suitable existing theme with scoped customization.
Astro/headless storefront only if a specific need outweighs integration cost.
impacts: Navigation, section layouts, components and cart interactions
checks: Inspect and reuse current theme tokens/components.
Verify form states, focus and mobile checkout entry.
technologies.versionPlan: No versions are fabricated or installed in this planning example. Before implementation, inspect existing manifests, choose compatible supported releases, record exact versions in the lockfile, and test updates.

technologies.name: Shopify staff accounts + two-step authentication
technologies.role: Staff identity and role-based administration. Guest buying is the proposed customer path.
technologies.rationale: Reuses the managed administration login instead of building a parallel password database.
technologies.tradeoffs: Recovery, account ownership and least-privilege roles must be configured and rehearsed.
alternatives: Customer accounts deferred until a repeat-customer task needs them.
impacts: Staff access, handover, recovery and account offboarding
checks: Test loss of access and approved recovery.
Verify a content editor cannot administer unrelated sensitive settings.
technologies.versionPlan: No versions are fabricated or installed in this planning example. Before implementation, inspect existing manifests, choose compatible supported releases, record exact versions in the lockfile, and test updates.

technologies.name: Theme checks + Playwright + axe-core
technologies.role: Local validation and browser checks on changed journeys.
technologies.rationale: Tests buying and staff handoff behavior rather than just screenshots.
technologies.tradeoffs: Automation cannot establish whether copy is persuasive or product advice is correct.
checks: Test validation, reset, keyboard use and error recovery.
Review real mobile renderings and contrast.
technologies.source: Proposed test stack; use the existing installed web-quality toolkit where applicable.
technologies.versionPlan: No versions are fabricated or installed in this planning example. Before implementation, inspect existing manifests, choose compatible supported releases, record exact versions in the lockfile, and test updates.
